audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 2 Kings / Melakhim Bet Athaliah, Joash rescue, temple coup, coronation, and execution narrative, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for royal-child massacre, Jehosheba's rescue, six-year concealment, Jehoiada's armed temple plan, covenant and coronation, Athaliah's protest, execution outside sanctuary, Baal-temple destruction, priest killing, and transfer of the child king to palace.

verses.restored: Athaliah mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, and she rose and destroyed all seed of kingdom.

familiar.text: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.

verses.restored: But Jehosheba daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him from among king's sons being put to death, him and his nurse in bedchamber; they hid him from Athaliah, and he was not put to death.

familiar.text: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons which were slain; and they hid him, even him and his nurse, in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

verses.restored: He was with her hidden in house of YHWH six years, while Athaliah reigned over land.

familiar.text: And he was with her hid in the house of the LORD six years. And Athaliah did reign over the land.

verses.restored: In seventh year Jehoiada sent and took commanders of hundreds of Carites and runners and brought them to him in house of YHWH. He cut covenant with them, made them swear in house of YHWH, and showed them king's son.

familiar.text: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of the LORD, and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of the LORD, and shewed them the king’s son.

verses.restored: He commanded them, saying, This is thing you shall do: one third of you who enter on Sabbath shall keep watch of king's house,

familiar.text: And he commanded them, saying, This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;

verses.restored: one third at gate Sur, and one third at gate behind runners; you shall keep watch of house in alternation.

familiar.text: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.

verses.restored: Two divisions of you, all who go out on Sabbath, shall keep watch of house of YHWH around king.

familiar.text: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the LORD about the king.

verses.restored: You shall surround king, each man with weapons in hand; one who comes within ranks shall be put to death. Be with king when he goes out and when he comes in.

familiar.text: And ye shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain: and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in.

verses.restored: Commanders of hundreds did according to all Jehoiada the priest commanded. Each took his men entering on Sabbath and going out on Sabbath and came to Jehoiada the priest.

familiar.text: And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

verses.restored: The priest gave commanders of hundreds spears and shields that belonged to king David, which were in house of YHWH.

familiar.text: And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David’s spears and shields, that were in the temple of the LORD.

verses.restored: Runners stood, each man with weapons in hand, from right side of house to left side of house, by altar and house, around king.

familiar.text: And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, round about the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, along by the altar and the temple.

verses.restored: He brought out king's son, put crown upon him and testimony, and they made him king and anointed him; they clapped hands and said, Let king live!

familiar.text: And he brought forth the king’s son, and put the crown upon him, and gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king.

verses.restored: Athaliah heard voice of runners and people and came to people at house of YHWH.

familiar.text: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of the LORD.

verses.restored: She looked, and behold, king standing by pillar according to custom, commanders and trumpets beside king, and all people of land rejoicing and blowing trumpets. Athaliah tore her garments and cried, Conspiracy! Conspiracy!

familiar.text: And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.

verses.restored: Jehoiada the priest commanded commanders of hundreds, officers of army, and said to them, Bring her out between ranks, and whoever goes after her put to death by sword; for priest had said, Let her not be put to death in house of YHWH.

familiar.text: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the LORD.

verses.restored: They laid hands upon her, and she went by way of horses' entrance to king's house, and there she was put to death.

familiar.text: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king’s house: and there was she slain.

verses.restored: Jehoiada cut covenant between YHWH and king and people, to be people of YHWH, and between king and people.

familiar.text: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD’s people; between the king also and the people.

verses.restored: All people of land came to house of Baal and tore it down; its altars and images they broke thoroughly, and Mattan priest of Baal they killed before altars. The priest appointed overseers over house of YHWH.

familiar.text: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the LORD.

verses.restored: He took commanders of hundreds, Carites, runners, and all people of land; they brought king down from house of YHWH and came by way of gate of runners to king's house. He sat upon throne of kings.

familiar.text: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of the LORD, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.

verses.restored: All people of land rejoiced, and city was quiet; Athaliah they had put to death by sword at king's house.

familiar.text: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king’s house.

verses.restored: Joash was seven years old when he became king.

familiar.text: Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign.

translation_notes: Athaliah is blamed for destroying the royal seed, but her portrayal comes through a hostile dynastic narrative. Her actions remain murderous without turning her into a misogynistic archetype of female rule.
Jehosheba and the nurse save Joash from a royal-child massacre. Their courage and caregiving are central to the survival story.
Joash is concealed in the temple for six years and crowned at seven. A child king remains a child subject to adult agendas, not proof that youth can safely carry sovereign power.
Jehoiada organizes an armed coup inside sacred space, including a lethal perimeter around the child. Temple authority does not automatically legitimate political violence.
Athaliah cries 'conspiracy' accurately: a coup is underway, even if the narrative supports it.
She is executed outside the temple to avoid sanctuary pollution; relocation of execution does not create due process.
The destruction of Baal's temple and killing of Mattan are religious violence and must never authorize attacks on other faith communities.
Covenant between YHWH, king, and people should not be used to fuse religion and state into theocracy or leader immunity.
Public joy and city quiet after a coup report the winners' perspective and do not erase the dead, frightened, or politically silenced.
safety_note: Do not use 2 Kings 11 to justify child rulers, palace massacres, armed temple coups, execution without trial, misogyny toward women in power, theocracy, religious-site destruction, or killing clergy of another tradition. Center Jehosheba's rescue, the child's vulnerability, and the difference between dynastic success and ethical justice.
